title: General Engineering Consultant Services RTE D06
short_description: General engineering consulting services for various Ohio DOT District 6 transportation projects.
project_scope: Two-year task-order-based general engineering consultant contract for various projects in Ohio Department of Transportation District 6. The notice indicates multidisciplinary support for streets/highways projects, including civil, geotechnical, electrical, mechanical, structural, utility, and traffic design engineering. No specific individual project, bridge type, span, or building size is defined in the notice.
services: General engineering consultant services on a task-order basis for various District 6 projects; disciplines requested include civil engineering, geotechnical engineering, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, structural engineering, utility engineering, and traffic design engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Framework-style general engineering services for various unspecified highway projects.
- No clearly defined bridge, special structure, or architecturally demanding scope.
- Includes structural engineering, but the notice is broad and not focused on a specific technically ambitious structure.
- sbp guidance says framework agreements without technical specification are generally not desired.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee stated in the source. Only a total construction cost of 1.5 million USD is mentioned, but this appears to relate broadly to the opportunity and is insufficient to derive a reliable sbp fee for unspecified task orders.
references_qualifications: Consultant team should cover the requested disciplines: civil, geotechnical, electrical, mechanical, structural, utility, and traffic design engineering. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
contracting_authority: Ohio Department of Transportation, District 6, Delaware, OH, USA. Contact: Cheryl Slone. Email: cheryl.slone@dot.ohio.gov. Phone: 614-466-7170. Website: https://www.transportation.ohio.gov/working/engineering/consultant-services
notes: Target market is streets/highways. Source states Project No. 117446, PID No. 117446, Group 5.4.26. RFQ/RFP package expected before June 1, 2026. Contract duration may be two years. The notice is for general consultant services rather than a defined single project.
